name: creative-ring
title: Creative ring
description: Twelve tiles around the middle of a square in the post's exact places: eight creatives, four tiles of the brand light, and the lockup inside.
use_for: A cover, a social post or the center of a section that says everything is in one place. The middle holds the lockup, nothing else.
never: A headline or a paragraph in the middle: only the lockup
Tiles moved off the post's places, or spun
source: Figma page 8: Post, Creative ring (1080x1080; creatives 128x128, 112x146 and 160x114; Light tile 112x145 and 128x128; Spyglass lockup 261x40 in the middle)
